
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/formulahendry/p/19762347" title="发布于 2026-03-24 10:33">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">基于微信 iLink API，微信可以连上 Claude、Code、Copilot、Qwen、Gemini、OpenCode 等各类 Agent！</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p><span>前两天，微信官方推出了 <span>OpenClaw 的支持，可以在微信聊天中，直接操控小龙虾！</span></span></p>
<p><span>我深挖了一下相应的源码，</span>发现底层其实是基于 iLink API 进行消息通信的！endpoint 是&nbsp;<em>ilinkai.weixin.qq.com</em>，通过 REST API 进行交互。</p>
<p><span>那么，事情就好办了！</span></p>
<p><span>我是不是能做一个通过&nbsp;<span>WeChat&nbsp;<span>Bridge，通过&nbsp;<span>ACP 来连上任意的 <span>ACP Agent？</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p><span>于是，马上开搞！</span>一把梭，发布：</p>
<p><a href="https://github.com/formulahendry/wechat-acp" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/formulahendry/wechat-acp</a></p>
<p><span>你只需要运行一行命令：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>npx -y wechat-acp --agent copilot</pre>
</div>
<p>用微信扫二维码，然后就能在微信里面操控 Copilot CLI 了！</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1857417/202603/1857417-20260324103005249-114505033.png" alt="image" width="457" height="1016" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span>当然，也内置了其他主流 Agent：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>npx -y wechat-acp agents</pre>
</div>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1857417/202603/1857417-20260324103053421-505312244.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span>也可以启动其他 Agent：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>npx wechat-acp --agent <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">npx my-agent --acp</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span></pre>
</div>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1857417/202603/1857417-20260324103106876-1054363538.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span>代码完全开源：</span></p>
<p><a href="https://github.com/formulahendry/wechat-acp" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow"><span>https://github.com/formulahendry/wechat-acp</span></a></p>
<span>欢迎来试用或者围观！</span>

</div>
<div class="clear"></div>
